## Checklist

- [ ] Started from `docs/templates/filament.md` and saved it as `src/content/filaments/<name>.md`

- [ ] Ratings (1-5) describe a *typical* filament of this type, not one brand
- [ ] At least one source for the temperatures and claims (datasheet, test, reputable guide)
- [ ] Any photo is mine or openly licensed, with `imageAlt` and `imageCredit`
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
